This folder contains the offline installer bundled into the Legacy release zip.

File: NDP46-KB3045557-x86-x64-AllOS-ENU.exe
Runtime: Microsoft .NET Framework 4.6 offline installer
Purpose: reduce setup friction on Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8, and Windows 8.1 machines that cannot easily download the runtime.

Keep this file out of the main Win10/11 Full and Lite packages. It is only copied into ezgetBMCIP-legacy-net46.zip.
